Wrote fees C$49.50-60.50 a day GST included (old note said ~$42-47), season May 1 - Oct 14, 107 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, 120-day online booking. Good Sam: no longer affiliated. flags: WEBSITE: replace the tourism listing with the operator's own site https://camroservpark.com/ (booking: https://properties.reservationfriend.com/camrose-rv-park/reservations).
PHONE: the operator's site, its booking page and Google all give 780-672-0287; the stored 780-678-2888 appears on none of them.

PRICE GATE: C$49.50-60.50 a day including GST (C$65 for a 50-amp prime site on holiday weekends) - under C$69. No gateway within 40 km (Elk Island NP 66 km, Edmonton 76 km). The rates page has no year on it; the home page dates itself with 'now closed for the 2026 season'.

LONG-STAY: weekly and prepaid 1-month / 3-month rates are posted ('Additional months will be calculated at the prorated amount'), and the home page mentions 'a winter snowbird coming home'. Nights are sold online with no minimum stated and no application; the share of monthly sites is not published; Esri imagery (undated) shows about half the pads occupied, all RVs. No test fails on what is published.
EVENT WEEK: 'Big Valley Jamboree is subject to event pricing and terms, full payment to be made at time of booking and no refunds on cancellations'; BVJ camping is not sold online.

OWNERSHIP (stored private, not changed): the site places the park 'on the CRE grounds' (Camrose Regional Exhibition, an agricultural society per the stored note); the operator's pages do not name who runs it.
